title: Codex MetaForge shared memory rollout
summary: Build a local dialogue memory bridge and connect Codex conversations to the shared MetaForge snapshot/context package.
constraints: Explicit validation is required before claiming delivery.
decisions: Use local dialogue ledger as the shared memory bridge.

messages.content: Build a local storage memory mechanism so Codex conversations can share state with the MetaForge system.
Use the existing memory/context framework to build a shared dialogue ledger and connect it into the MetaForge snapshot and context package.
